scientific_question: On CED-VAL-010, does an event-blind continuous representation of upper-partial harmonic structure preserve the same PRESERVED-greater-than-MISSED directional association independently observed retrospectively across CED-VAL-005, CED-VAL-006 and CED-VAL-009?

input_authorities.role: sole primary original Bass observation authority

authority_limitations: No physical-onset, shared-hardware-clock, simultaneous-acquisition, sample-accurate-synchronization or undocumented-editing authority is asserted. Sample-zero coordinates are preserved exactly as supplied.

controlled_mix.population: all ten checksum-authorized musical WAVs; exclude README and AppleDouble sidecars
controlled_mix.decode: exact signed 24-bit little-endian PCM to int64
controlled_mix.channel_mapping: preserve stereo; duplicate mono exactly to left and right
controlled_mix.summation: exact int64 addition in UTF-8 filename-byte lexicographic order over unchanged common sample coordinates
controlled_mix.planning: dry pass determines complete unscaled absolute peak; sole coefficient 8388607/peak is frozen before WAV generation
controlled_mix.quantization: round to nearest, half away from zero
controlled_mix.replay: two independent generations must be byte-identical

pre_gt_continuous_evidence.epsilon: max(float64 tiny, median positive frame power * 1e-12)
pre_gt_continuous_evidence.harmonic_score: mean across eight partials of log1p(interpolated partial power/(median local-background power+epsilon))
pre_gt_continuous_evidence.local_maximum: interior F0-grid score >= both adjacent scores and > at least one; endpoints excluded/range-censored; no magnitude cutoff

node_dimensions.partial_prominence_dispersion: population standard deviation across the eight per-partial prominence values

pre_gt_continuous_evidence.preservation: every measurable local-F0 maximum and all four separate continuous dimensions; no composite, threshold, pruning or event formation

chunking.integrity: whole versus artificial chunk boundary must be exactly equal

pre_gt_continuous_evidence.canonical_replay: two complete acquisitions; all canonical artifacts byte-identical; runtime excluded from canonical serialization
pre_gt_continuous_evidence.freeze: canonical evidence serialized, hashed, fingerprinted and committed before BassDI is opened for event analysis

ground_truth_firewall: Before the PRE-GT evidence commit, do not open BassDI or BassMic for outcome/event analysis; do not derive Bass events, correspondence, PRESERVED/MISSED labels or inspect any outcome. Controlled-mix byte reading includes BassDI and BassMic only as blind summands and may not produce source-specific measurements.

post_freeze_original_observation.primary: unchanged production JGA observation of 06_BassDI.wav over [0,7422225); sole Bass GT observation authority
post_freeze_original_observation.candidate: unchanged production JGA observation of frozen separated bass.wav over the same scope
post_freeze_original_observation.bassmic: 05_BassMic.wav may be observed only after the primary evaluation is serialized; descriptive non-decisional comparison only; cannot replace BassDI, alter a population, rescue a result or select parameters

correspondence.cells: half-open original-event Voronoi cells [left,right), bounded by 0 and 7422225/44100 seconds
correspondence.selection: chronological originals; unused in-cell separated candidate with minimum absolute displacement, then earlier time, then lower native identity
correspondence.tolerance: Voronoi-cell authority only; no correction or added tolerance

populations.PRESERVED: original BassDI observations receiving one match
populations.MISSED: original BassDI observations receiving no match

negative_population.role: descriptive specificity/context only; no decision-gate effect
negative_population.count: same per-bin count as original BassDI EME
negative_population.lattice: 10000 equally spaced interior midpoints per bin
negative_population.exclusion: inclusive +/-0.050 seconds from every original BassDI EME
negative_population.selection: first eligible coordinates in increasing order; no evidence access

event_centered_evaluation.window: inclusive +/-0.050 seconds by LONG frame-start coordinate; no correction
event_centered_evaluation.partial_prominence_dispersion: dispersion at maximum-harmonic-score node; ties earliest global frame then lowest F0 index
event_centered_evaluation.unavailable: null with explicit reason when no complete LONG frame or local maximum exists; no imputation
event_centered_evaluation.statistics: for PRESERVED, MISSED and NEGATIVE: n available/unavailable, minimum, Q1, median, Q3, maximum; PRESERVED versus MISSED and descriptive comparisons versus NEGATIVE: Cliff's delta, rank AUC and two-sided Mann-Whitney U
event_centered_evaluation.uncertainty: 95 percent percentile bootstrap CI for Cliff's delta, 10000 deterministic resamples, NumPy PCG64 seeds 20260901 plus measurement ordinal
event_centered_evaluation.orientation: positive delta and AUC above 0.5 mean PRESERVED is higher than MISSED

decision_rule_priority.INDETERMINATE: any authority, checksum, pre-GT firewall, separation replay, chunk-integrity, evidence replay, GT derivation, correspondence or evaluation replay invariant fails; or either PRESERVED/MISSED availability is below 80 percent for any primary dimension
decision_rule_priority.INDEPENDENT_HARMONIC_STRUCTURE_REPLICATI: all four PRESERVED-versus-MISSED Cliff's deltas are >= +0.147
SUPPORTED is not met, at least three of four deltas are > 0, and at least two of four deltas are >= +0.147

decision_authority: Only the four separate BassDI-based PRESERVED-versus-MISSED effects enter the decision. P-values, NEGATIVE comparisons, BassMic, prior datasets and secondary descriptions cannot change or rescue classification.
interpretation: Directional replication is association with observation preservation in this bounded material, not causation, source identity, physical onset, recovery validation or a production rule.
protocol_fingerprint_method: SHA-256 of jq -cS JSON after deleting protocol_fingerprint, including one trailing LF
